about.headline: About
paragraphs: ROOTS & EARLY LIFE: Born in Perugupalli village, Veligandla mandal, Daddala Narayana Yadav Garu grew up in the heartland of Telugu soil. He comes from the very fabric of Prakasam's working people—a background that taught him early on what struggle really means. Watching farmers toil in the fields, laborers build with their bare hands, and families dream of a better tomorrow, young Narayana understood something profound: that politics must serve the forgotten, or it serves no one.

EDUCATION & SHAPING: His education—B.Sc from G.C. & YPN Degree College, Kanigiri (2004) and B.Ed from M.V.J. College of Education, Bangalore (2006)—prepared him not just with degrees, but with the conviction that knowledge is meant to lift up, not to elevate only the learned few. This foundation would shape a leader who believes in translating understanding into action.

ENTRY INTO POLITICS & RISE: From the grassroots of his village to the broader political stage, his journey in YSRCP (active since 2014) has been one of building trust, one connection at a time. Appointed as the Kanigiri YSRCP in-charge in 2024, he has proven that loyalty to the people matters more than closeness to power. His role as a ZPTC member from Hanumanthunipadu mandal further demonstrates his commitment to serving at every level of governance. He didn't arrive as a stranger to leadership—he built it brick by brick, through consistent service.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS & IMPACT: Since entering public life, he has transformed Kanigiri into a political force centered on people, not slogans. He has organized farmer collectives to ensure their voices reach decision-makers, mobilized women's self-help groups to create economic independence, and engaged youth wings in constructive political participation. His work as a local administrator and businessman has shown him firsthand how systems either serve or exploit—and he has chosen the path of service. His charitable work through community initiatives demonstrates that his words about the poor are backed by action, not mere rhetoric.

PERSONAL LIFE & HUMILITY: At home, Daddala Narayana Yadav Garu remains a simple son of the soil. His spouse, Daddala Manjubhargavi, serves as sarpanch of Hussainpuram panchayat—a partnership rooted in shared values of community service. He still walks the streets of Kanigiri like a neighbor, not like someone who has 'arrived.' His business background (as a realtor and granite entrepreneur) keeps him grounded in the reality of how ordinary people navigate livelihoods and struggles. He respects elders, listens more than he speaks in private, and never forgets the village that made him who he is.

CURRENT ROLE & PEOPLE-FIRST STYLE: More than an office-holder, Narayana Yadav Garu is a village-wanderer, temple-visitor, and trusted friend to thousands. As Kanigiri YSRCP in-charge, he doesn't hide in conference rooms—he visits villages to listen, sits with farmers during planting season, stands with workers during crises, and ensures that every person who reaches out gets a hearing. His door is always open. His phone is always answered. His promise is simple: if you bring a genuine problem, you will get a genuine effort to solve it.

VISION FOR THE FUTURE: His dream for Kanigiri is clear and inspiring: a constituency where no farmer sells his land out of desperation or fear; where every child, regardless of family wealth, graduates with dignity and skill; where villages receive healthcare, roads, and schools not as favors, but as rights; where women don't just survive, but thrive with real opportunities; where youth see a future worth staying for. Most importantly, a Kanigiri where public power is always used to serve and lift up—never to exploit, never to divide, never to forget. This is not just a slogan; it is the mission of a leader who has lived the struggles he seeks to solve.

VERIFIED PUBLIC FACTS (2024 election affidavit, via MyNeta/ADR):
• Constituency: Kanigiri (Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh)
• Party: YSRCP
• Age: 42 years
• Education: B.Sc (G.C. & YPN Degree College, Kanigiri — 2004) and B.Ed (M.V.J. College of Education, Bangalore — 2006)
• Professional Background: Business (Real Estate & Granite Trade) and Political Leadership
• Criminal cases declared: 3 (refer to original affidavit for details)
• Total Assets declared: ₹3,68,19,218
• Total Liabilities declared: ₹1,70,09,907
(For the most recent and complete information, please refer to the latest affidavit on the Election Commission of India archive or MyNeta portal.)

REPORTED IN LOCAL MEDIA (Sakshi, Jan 19, 2024):
• YSR Congress Party leadership announced him as YSRCP in-charge for Kanigiri constituency
• From Perugupalli village, Veligandla mandal—where his roots run deep
• Serving as ZPTC (Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency) member from Hanumanthunipadu mandal
• Active in YSRCP since 2014, building grassroots support and connecting with constituents
• Known in local business community as a realtor and granite businessman
• Spouse: Daddala Manjubhargavi, sarpanch (village headwoman) of Hussainpuram panchayat
(Source: https://www.sakshi.com/telugu-news/prakasam/1921972)

PUBLIC PROFILE & ONGOING WORK:
• YouTube official channel: Kanigiri Assembly Constituency @ysrcongress Incharge
(Source: https://www.youtube.com/@Dr.DaddalaNarayanaYadav)
• Since appointment as in-charge, has actively engaged with district administration, law enforcement, and local governance bodies to strengthen support systems for Kanigiri residents
• Reported public activity (Lokal Telugu, Jan 23, 2024): Met with Prakasam district SP Mallika Garg to coordinate on public safety and development initiatives
(Source: https://telugu.getlokalapp.com/andhra-news/prakasam-new/kanigiri/kanigiri-ycp-in-charge-who-met-the-sp-12453146)

"This is not about power. This is about people. Every farmer, every worker, every woman, every child in Kanigiri deserves to know that someone is fighting for them. And I will never stop." — Daddala Narayana Yadav Garu
